title: MIHVER Local Publication Receipt
description: Machine-readable result of the deterministic Local Publication Builder (scripts/dev/publication-builder.mjs), per V3.1-A. Reports a local commit only -- it never reports a push or a remote PR state, since the builder never performs either. Consumed by Claude for its own report, and is the artifact the future privileged Publication Broker (V3.1-B, not implemented here) will independently re-verify before any remote effect.

remote_name.description: A literal git remote identifier: every character must be printable ASCII (U+0021-U+007E, so no whitespace/control character, no DEL, and -- unlike a negated-range approach -- correctly excluding every non-ASCII code point including astral ones such as emoji, since JSON Schema regex engines are Unicode-code-point-aware and a negated upper-bound range like [^...-\uFFFF] does not exclude a code point above U+FFFF), no path separator, no ref-like special character anywhere in the value, and must not start with '-'. See Closeout Pack A.2.1, Work Package C. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateRemoteName; a shared parity matrix (including astral cases) is checked by both tests/dev/publication-remote-name-parity.test.mjs and internal/repoidentity/repoidentity_test.go's remoteNameParityMatrix.

owner.description: 1-39 ASCII alphanumeric/hyphen characters, begins and ends with an alphanumeric character, no consecutive hyphens. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateOwner.

name.description: 1-100 ASCII alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen characters; not exactly '.' or '..'; not composed only of '.' characters. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateName.

commit_sha.description: Required (non-schema-enforced) when status is COMMITTED; absent on BLOCKED.

local_head.description: HEAD after the builder ran -- equals commit_sha on COMMITTED, equals pre_publish_head on BLOCKED (no commit made).

failure_reason.description: Required (non-schema-enforced), exact, machine-readable reason when status is BLOCKED; absent on COMMITTED.
